summary: The agent failed the test suite despite appearing to generate correct outputs. The trace shows the agent correctly implemented the deterministic policy and produced files with proper structure. However, the test failure suggests the verifier found a discrepancy. Key issues to capture: (1) The agent correctly identified this as a capacity planning task but didn't explicitly consult the existing excel-capacity-planning skill, (2) The initial backlog was derived from 'initial condition = 1014.51' correctly, (3) The agent used CSV reading which is acceptable for .csv files (unlike .xlsx which requires pandas/openpyxl), (4) The core logic appears correct but test failure indicates possible precision, column naming, or state-carry issues. This update adds shipbuilding/ship block planning as a known variant to the existing skill and adds CSV input pattern recognition.
